# exec_credentials

:::info[Typed specification]

Generated by the pinned `ess generate --kind docs` from [`adapters/kubernetes/spec/ess`](https://github.com/beyond10x/connectors/tree/main/adapters/kubernetes/spec/ess). Structural validation establishes consistency; behaviour, storage and cross-record predicates remain implementation obligations.

Kubernetes-owned exec credential plugin binding, its kubeconfig selection, the credential lifetime it observes and the refusals of one plugin run.

`connectors_kubernetes.exec_credentials` is one of connectors_kubernetes's bounded contexts. [Back to the index](../index.md).

## Types

### `ExecCredentialApiVersion`

`connectors_kubernetes.exec_credentials.ExecCredentialApiVersion` is one of `client_authentication_v1` and `client_authentication_v1beta1`.

### `ExecCredentialLifetime`

`connectors_kubernetes.exec_credentials.ExecCredentialLifetime` is a record of one field:

- `expires_at_ms` — `Optional<Integer>`, which may be absent

### `ExecPluginAdmission`

`connectors_kubernetes.exec_credentials.ExecPluginAdmission` is one of `off` and `pinned`.

### `ExecPluginBinding`

`connectors_kubernetes.exec_credentials.ExecPluginBinding` is a record of six fields:

- `path` — `String`
- `sha256` — `String`
- `user` — `String`
- `env` — `List<String>`
- `home` — `Optional<String>`, which may be absent
- `timeout_ms` — `Integer`

Every value satisfies `(path.count >= 2 and path.count <= 4096)`, `(sha256.count >= 64 and sha256.count <= 64)`, `(user.count >= 1 and user.count <= 256)`, `env.count <= 32`, `(not (defined(home)) or (home.count >= 2 and home.count <= 4096))` and `(timeout_ms >= 1 and timeout_ms <= 60000)`.

### `ExecPluginRefusal`

`connectors_kubernetes.exec_credentials.ExecPluginRefusal` is one of `digest_mismatch`, `plugin_unavailable`, `kubeconfig_mismatch`, `timeout`, `output_too_large`, `malformed_credential` and `plugin_failed`.

### `ExecPluginSelection`

`connectors_kubernetes.exec_credentials.ExecPluginSelection` is a record of four fields:

- `api_version` — `connectors_kubernetes.exec_credentials.ExecCredentialApiVersion`
- `command` — `String`
- `args` — `List<String>`
- `env_names` — `List<String>`

Every value satisfies `(command.count >= 1 and command.count <= 4096)`, `args.count <= 64` and `env_names.count <= 32`.

Five of the types above are reached by nothing else in this system: `connectors_kubernetes.exec_credentials.ExecCredentialLifetime`, `connectors_kubernetes.exec_credentials.ExecPluginAdmission`, `connectors_kubernetes.exec_credentials.ExecPluginBinding`, `connectors_kubernetes.exec_credentials.ExecPluginRefusal` and `connectors_kubernetes.exec_credentials.ExecPluginSelection`. No entity, view, command, event, error or crossing names them, so it is either vocabulary something outside this specification uses or a leftover — and only a person can tell which.
